title: See-through Crepe Cap Sleeve Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Turn heads in this enchanting see-through crepe dress! Featuring delicate cap sleeves and a flowy silhouette, it's the perfect blend of elegance and allure. Ideal for wedding guests or special occasions, this dress ensures you shine with effortless sophistication.


Tips: Made of high-stretch fabric with at least 2 inches of stretch.
Select your size based on the standard size chart.
If there is a significant difference between your bust, waist, and hip measurements, prioritize the bust measurement when choosing.
For a tighter fit, please choose one size smaller.

 

Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: High low.


Sleeve Style: Cap sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises crepe.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
